title: Certify ite terms over the uninterpreted sort in QF_UF refutations
summary: The QF_UF certificate pipeline now accepts if-then-else terms over the uninterpreted sort, rendering them as Lean's ite with Lean-checked gate clauses, and fixes two older clause-log replay gaps found by random nested-ite inputs. All 28 gating CI checks passed in one round and the reviewer approved with three nits, one of which was fixed.
